name: BROKEN CORE: sister = doll, a girl story
source:
linear visual novel of 20k words about why being a doll and a sister and a girl all means the same thing

[From [url=https://nadianova.itch.io/broken-core]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部兩萬詞的線性視覺小說，講述為什麼當個人偶、當個姐妹、當個女孩，說的都是同一回事。
